name: Jump Rope

instructions.description: Stand with the rope behind the heels and handles at the sides.
Turn the rope from the wrists and make small jumps as it passes.
Land softly with knees slightly bent.
Stop before rhythm or landing control is lost.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

commentsNotes: Select a clear surface and scale impact as needed.

variations.variationDescription: Jump Rope — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.
